description: This file defines a FastAPI application with a data model for an item, and an endpoint for updating items with complex request body parameters. It demonstrates the use of Pydantic models, FastAPI routing, and request body embedding.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: A Pydantic model representing an item with optional description and tax fields.

methods.name: update_item(item_id: int, item: Item = Body(embed=True))
methods.description: An asynchronous endpoint handler for updating an item, accepting item id and item data with embedded body parameter.

ctags.name: update_item
ctags.pattern: /^async def update_item(item_id: int, item: Item = Body(embed=True)):$/
